title: 商務進階必備字彙 (TOEIC 600-780) - 第 13 單元 (4801~5200 字)
description: 中階多益綠色至藍色證書核心單字，包含採購、會議、財務與差旅實戰。（分單元 13/14）

words.definitionZh: 暫停營業；攤位（如市場攤位）

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of stall.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【暫停營業】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in stall.
examples.zh: 廠房主管實施了嚴格的營運準則，以確保在【暫停營業】方面保持一致的高品質。

examples.en: Strategic investment in stall has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【暫停營業】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【暫停營業】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。
quizzes.strategy: 空格位於 corporate 之後作為名詞主詞/受詞，選入名詞 stall 最切合商務方針。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意名詞單複數與可數/不可數之文法特徵。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「暫停營業」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

quizzes.stem: In the business memorandum, the word 'stall' is closest in meaning to which of the following?
quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「stall」（【暫停營業】）的意思與下列何者最接近？
quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，stall（暫停營業）之核心涵義與 stall 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。

To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📧【內部備忘錄】
收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.
quizzes.stemTranslation:

To: All Branch Directors
Subject: Long-term Development Framework

The executive board has approved comprehensive guidelines to _____ sustainable performance across all regional subsidiaries.
